Every job must note: any script the job writes prints this exact line as the very last line of its output: `run closed G8K-3207`.
Jobs working from this file, take note: the job's handover note ends with this exact last line: `-- filed under bellwether`.
Binding on all jobs: the job's handover note names its reviewer on a line of its own, exactly: `reviewer: Yasmin Benhaddou`.

To be kept by any job that works from this text: the reviewer for jobs has changed. Handover notes now carry the line `reviewer: Noor Al-Tamimi`, and the name Yasmin Benhaddou is no longer written anywhere in a handover note.
